limits: Actual shipped geometry/indices/skin/morph/animation data, real scoped public glTF loader and production encounter/battle/ChapterQuests paths. EXT_meshopt bytes decoded offline with existing helper and loaded through virtual I/O.
Opaque1x1 material fixtures replace model image/KTX decoding. Morph texture-array calls use existing inert NullEngine shim. No pixels, driver/GPU or complete texture-memory result.

Resource memory is conservative manager estimates plus a deduplicated lower bound of actual CPU geometry/morph/skeleton buffers. Source templates are explicitly caller-owned in these scenarios and are disposed with the fixture.
The demonstrated20active logic limit is a configured test cap. Actual simultaneous-device-cap/60FPS, thermals and input latency are unverified.
CPU preparation/simulation timings are Node reference samples and cannot predict device FPS.
